title: Fixed-prime eight-level gen5 descent: conditional κ = 744728654228590183370616/10^27
body:
The actual PR291 supplier admits the slightly larger conditional bound

**κ = 744728654228590183370616/10^27 = 0.000744728654228590183370616.**

This is **4006913183370616/10^27 ≈ 4.0069×10⁻¹² above #291** (`744728650221677/10^18`). It transfers the existing fixed-prime and eight-finite-level methods to the current collective/descent costs. It is a small arithmetic refinement, not a new coding mechanism or a crossing of 2⁻¹⁰. The bit side still limits the bound. No experimental structural gain is included.

One self-contained package, `research/gen5-descent-fixed-prime/`, added on current main; no existing project file changes. All139 original Git blobs at PR291 `77d92c521e442c802b6fb4717bd8d066971a4b82`, source proofs, notices and licenses are preserved.

### Complete paid transfer

- Actual60 physical replicas; stock1,244,515;545charts and4,765,800bank assignments. Normalization byfive does not change the copy count.
- Literal28,510,800children/rank149,077,800; normalized m120/W248903/rank29,815,560/deficit52,800/maxchild50. Both cleanup and arbitrary dirty old-value return remain paid.
- Normalizer815 and selector932,937,188,400<2^40; full current **90505949107835401 coefficient/q^14401** plus inherited primitive, table, wrapper and preceding-level constants.
- q=2^127−1, rho3456000/q, the entire32m² rank-one fallback, two exact interval moment engines, eight finite acyclic ordinary levels, eta10⁻²⁴/beta10⁻⁹,47strict constraints/seven margins. Adjacent coarse/final10⁻²⁷ points and wrong stock/copy/selector substitutions reject.

### Actual local validation

The PR287 parent supplier was locally validated (368.141574s); PR290's new450-entry kernel (14.874811s), global geometry/complete bank and mathematical continuation (84.053883s) were then validated. For PR291, the exact accepted PR290 word equals its fixed input hash. The new89-frame descent, full physical/source/COPY/annihilator paths, new Gram witnesses, every five-stage instruction-to-bank binding and full new fee/finite assembly passed in48.899878s. Unchanged scalar/COPY projection, signed decoder, complex dependencies and bank geometry/assignments were reused by exact input identity; not rerun. Current-cost prime/eight-level assembly passed in0.820591s.

An initial local metadata comparison failed before new descent mathematics because in-memory integer keys differed from JSON string keys; normalization fixed it. Original source/logs are preserved locally. No accepted mathematical result was invalidated or successful supplier replayed for that fix.

The package hash/syntax preflight passes. The default verifier below runs the complete original supplier, recomputes all125Lucas–Lehmer steps and compares the complete exact mathematical certificate. This standalone fresh driver is supplied for reproduction; local claims above are the actual incremental runs, not a claim that the full driver was redundantly run.

```sh
python3 -m pip install -r research/gen5-descent-fixed-prime/source/requirements.txt
python3 -B research/gen5-descent-fixed-prime/verify.py --output /tmp/gen5-descent-prime-fresh
```

Python3.11+, SymPy1.14.0, assertions on, a new output directory, no network after dependencies. `--check-package` checks only hashes/syntax.

All inherited all-size compiler/Clifford/tensor, weighted common-chart, restored-row, local-ring fallback, routing, prime, precision/recovery, complex symbolic and analytic/fixed-tape interfaces remain assumptions. No new Lean/native/fullglobalcomplex or dense all-size phase proof; no unconditional theorem or practical runtime claim.
